references.text: Moses mentions Mount Ebal as the place where the curses are to be read, in preparation for this ceremony
Earlier instructions about setting up stones and plastering them when crossing the Jordan
Continuation of the instructions to write the words of the law clearly on the stones
Joshua carries out this command by building an altar on Mount Ebal and writing the law on stones
Instructions to use uncut stones for the altar, which is related to the stone monument
The Israelites set up twelve stones after crossing the Jordan, as a parallel stone-setting ceremony
